name: sandbox
notes: T1 research sandbox, offline and deterministic: no deploy, no consumers, no paid LLM run, synthetic data only. T1 is deliberate — promote only when something consumes the repo's output (first LLM pilot, paper, benchmark run, 2nd contributor); return-session count is NOT a trigger. If real human-subject or participant data ever enters, flip sensitive_data BEFORE it lands. Dual-runtime by owner request: Claude gets the deny floor from the GLOBAL PreToolUse hook (~/.claude/hooks/dispatch.py); Codex gets the SAME dispatcher via .codex/hooks.json with --runtime codex, and .codex/config.toml disables multi-agent fan-out. The floor is deliberately NOT vendored here (a repo copy would double-spawn alongside the global hook). Only the PRE deny event is wired at T1. Codex project hooks are trust-gated: review the new hash via /hooks after .codex/hooks.json changes. bypassPermissions lives in gitignored .claude/settings.local.json; committed .claude/settings.json keeps acceptEdits + the deny list as the fresh-clone baseline. human_todo=null: no human-action file at T1 — the human-owned decisions live in HANDOFF.md. Bootstrapped 2026-07-12; migrated from legacy .claude/tier.json on 2026-07-27.
